label: Schedule C — compensation band, explicit gap at $25,000
scenario: Schedule SE net earnings are $80,000, inside the $50,000 to $100,000 band. An explicit compensation figure of $55,000 is on the packet, so the gap is $25,000. Type 2b is must-review from that pair. It is not a flat $50,000 self-employment floor. The retirement deduction is already present, so SEP/Solo stays quiet. No payroll rates are on the packet, so no dollar estimate is attached.
